entries.semantic_rule: In pinned OCaml 4.14.1, Stdlib maps == to %eq, translprim maps %eq to Pintcomp Ceq, and structural = on int also specializes to Pintcomp Ceq; the runtime representation additionally encodes each int injectively as one tagged immediate word. The two predicates therefore select the same branch for every int value.

operations.after:
let partition p l =
  let rec part l =
    match l with
      [] -> [],[],true,true
    | h::t ->
        let yes,no,all_yes,all_no = part t in
        if p(h) then
          ((if all_yes then l else h::yes),no,all_yes,false)
        else
          (yes,(if all_no then l else h::no),false,all_no) in
  let yes,no,_,_ = part l in yes,no;;

let qmap _ _ =
  failwith "Candle Flyspeck: qmap requires physical sharing observation";;

operations.before:
let undefine =
  let rec undefine_list x l =
    match l with
      (a,b as ab)::t ->
          let c = Stdlib.compare x a in
          if c = 0 then t
          else if c < 0 then l else
          let t' = undefine_list x t in
          if t' == t then l else ab::t'
    | [] -> [] in
  fun x ->
    let k = Hashtbl.hash x in
    let rec und t =
      match t with
        Leaf(h,l) when h = k ->
          let l' = undefine_list x l in
          if l' == l then t
          else if l' = [] then Empty
          else Leaf(h,l')
      | Branch(p,b,l,r) when k land (b - 1) = p ->
          if k land b = 0 then
            let l' = und l in
            if l' == l then t
            else (match l' with Empty -> r | _ -> Branch(p,b,l',r))
          else
            let r' = und r in
            if r' == r then t
            else (match r' with Empty -> l | _ -> Branch(p,b,l,r'))
      | _ -> t in
    und;;

let undefine =
  let rec undefine_list_changed x l =
    match l with
      (a,b as ab)::t ->
          let c = Stdlib.compare x a in
          if c = 0 then Some t
          else if c < 0 then None else
          (match undefine_list_changed x t with
             None -> None
           | Some t' -> Some(ab::t'))
    | [] -> None in
  fun x ->
    let k = Hashtbl.hash x in
    let rec und_changed t =
      match t with
        Leaf(h,l) when h = k ->
          (match undefine_list_changed x l with
             None -> None
           | Some l' ->
               Some(if l' = [] then Empty else Leaf(h,l')))
      | Branch(p,b,l,r) when k land (b - 1) = p ->
          if k land b = 0 then
            (match und_changed l with
               None -> None
             | Some l' ->
                 Some(match l' with Empty -> r
                                    | _ -> Branch(p,b,l',r)))
          else
            (match und_changed r with
               None -> None
             | Some r' ->
                 Some(match r' with Empty -> l
                                    | _ -> Branch(p,b,l,r')))
      | _ -> None in
    fun t -> match und_changed t with None -> t | Some t' -> t';;

operations.before:
let run_command dir com =
  let cur_dir = Sys.getcwd() in
  let _ = Sys.chdir dir in
  let result = Sys.command com in
  let _ = Sys.chdir cur_dir in
    result;;

let create_tmp_dir base_dir = 
  let tmp_dir = Filename.concat base_dir "tmp" in
    if Sys.file_exists tmp_dir then
      if Sys.is_directory tmp_dir then
	if Array.length (Sys.readdir tmp_dir) > 0 then
	  failwith ("create_tmp_dir: the directory is not empty: " ^
		      tmp_dir)
	else
	  tmp_dir
      else
	failwith ("create_tmp_dir: cannot create the directory " ^
		    tmp_dir)
    else
      let _ = Unix.mkdir tmp_dir 0o777 in
	tmp_dir;;

let read_compressed_lp_certificates fname =
  let base_dir = Filename.dirname fname in
  let tmp_dir = create_tmp_dir base_dir in
  let cmd = Format.sprintf "tar -xvzf \"%s\"" fname in
  let _ = run_command tmp_dir cmd in
  let files = Sys.readdir tmp_dir in
  let certs =
    Array.fold_left 
      (fun all file ->
	 let fname = Filename.concat tmp_dir file in
	 let cs = read_raw_lp_certificates fname in
	   cs @ all) [] files in
  let _ = run_command base_dir (Format.sprintf "rm -rf \"%s\"" tmp_dir) in
    certs;;

let read_lp_certificates fname =
  if Filename.check_suffix fname ".gz" then
    read_compressed_lp_certificates fname
  else
    read_raw_lp_certificates fname;;
